name: anatomy
description: Build crafted, highly detailed, interactive isometric SVG figures that explain a technical idea as a real physical object. Stella invokes the self-contained Node.js anatomy kit in features/anatomy/ (no external PC-directory references). The skill runs `node features/anatomy/build.mjs` to generate a standalone HTML figure with embedded SVG, returns the SVG markup, the output file path, and the isometric projection used. Read operations (sources, examples, kit, workflow, verify, figure_plan, references) are free; writing a figure file needs authorized=true plus confirm=true plus a policy allow rule.

operation.description: One of: sources | examples | kit | workflow | verify | figure_plan | build | references. Defaults to sources.

example.description: Name of an example to build (examples/build operation). Defaults to dial-indicator.

module.description: Name of a kit module to describe (kit operation).

concept.description: The technical idea to explain (figure_plan operation).

size.description: Figure size tier: Figure | Hero | Epic (figure_plan operation). Defaults to Figure.

theme.description: Figure theme: dark | light (build operation). Defaults to dark.

width.description: Figure width in pixels (build operation). Defaults to 600.

height.description: Figure height in pixels (build operation). Defaults to 380.

turn.description: Dial turns for the needle position (dial-indicator build). Defaults to 0.9.

authorized.description: Must be true for any operation that writes a figure file (build).

confirm.description: Must be true to actually write a figure file (build).

limit.description: Maximum items to return. Defaults to 20.

author: Stella
notes: Self-contained Node.js kit in features/anatomy/kit/ and features/anatomy/build.mjs. No symlinks or references to any PC skill directory. Build writes to features/anatomy/out/ and needs authorized=true + confirm=true + an allow rule.
